en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a fortified medieval church with a tall clock‑tower and steep roof, surrounded by the roofs of an old town and backed by forested hills. To the left stands a separate ruined stone tower on a grassy slope. The caption beneath the image names the place in Hungarian and German. The reverse side contains a green stamp, a circular postmark, printed Hungarian text, and handwritten German correspondence and address lines.
